How to play怎么玩

Roll the die to move, take off when the runway clears and fly your planes along the track. Land on a rival to send it back to the hangar. First player to bring every plane home wins. Play with 2-4 friends locally or online, or practice against computer pilots.掷骰决定步数，飞机起飞后沿航道前进；落在对手飞机上可把它撞回基地。率先把全部飞机送达终点的玩家获胜。支持 2–4 人本地或在线同玩，也可与电脑练习。

每局结算按名次发放 200 / 100 / 50 / 50 Joy Coins；积分按名次发放 40 / 20 / 10 / 10，日、周、月排行榜只统计积分。登录后自动保存成绩，匿名对局不记入排行榜。

Membership & support会员与支持

Membership cosmetics change portraits, looks and flight trails; they never change dice, turn order or the winner. Online results are recorded per game, and signed-in accounts keep their Joy Coins automatically.会员装扮可更换头像、外观与飞行尾迹，不改变骰子规则、先后手或胜负。联机成绩按各游戏独立记录，登录账号自动累计 Joy Coins。
